item.description: Before the Independent Spirit Awards, Ceesay took a Coffee Break with IndieWire and Lavazza

item.title: What’s Up with Those Gin Bottle Mountains in ‘Wuthering Heights’? The Film’s Production Designer Explains
item.description: Production designer Suzie Davies tells IndieWire about designing a visual architecture based on the characters' feelings, not period accuracy.

item.title: Does Money Rid a Film of Its Independent Spirit?
item.description: As ceremonies geared toward indies, like the Film Independent Spirit Awards, try to find a new audience, the budget cap on which films can be nominated looks more burdensome.

item.title: Amy Madigan Talks Her Love of ‘Original, Vibrant, Difficult, Hard’ Independent Films on the Spirit Awards Carpet
item.description: The Oscar-nominated "Weapons" star and Independent Spirit Awards presenter joined IndieWire and Lavazza for a Coffee Break before the show.

item.title: Oscar Contenders Guillermo del Toro, Jafar Panahi, Clint Bentley, and More Trade Screenwriting Secrets
item.description: "The characters we've created won't submit to our preordained goals," said Oscar-nominated "Marty Supreme" co-writer Ronald Bronstein while on the Santa Barbara Film Festival Writers Panel.

item.title: ‘The Blood Countess’ Review: Isabelle Huppert Bites Into a Gloriously Costumed, Deeply Silly Vampire Tale as Erzsébet Báthory
item.description: Berlin: The star is murderously brilliant in Ulrike Ottinger's dark comedy about the infamous Blood Countess, but this very long two-hour movie crams in too many slapstick side characters to justify the blood-letting.

item.title: ‘A New Dawn’ Review: This Dull and Incoherent Anime Feature Debut Doesn’t Care About Its Audience
item.description: Berlin: "Your Name" filmmaker Makoto Shinkai's protégé, Yoshitoshi Shinomiya, delivers a feature debut that fails to bring its audience along for the ride, both in terms of animation and story.

item.title: ‘Sunny Dancer’ Review: Bella Ramsey Shines in a Sincere Coming-of-Age Story About Life After Chemo
item.description: Berlin: George Jaques' film about a summer camp for teenage cancer survivors plays familiar storytelling beats but elevates itself with an ensemble that deeply buys into the material.

item.title: ‘Lee Cronin’s The Mummy’ Trailer: Don’t Worry, It’s Fun to Be Dead
item.description: The "Evil Dead Rise" director teams up with Blumhouse and Atomic Monster for a modern twist on the Egyptian monster movie.

item.title: Who Is Department M, the Company in Talks to Acquire a Stake in Neon?
item.description: Mike Larocca, formerly of AGBO, and Michael Schaefer, the former New Regency president, formed the production company behind "The Christophers" two years ago.
